stations.title: Handwritten tag
stations.text: Hard to read on a busy Saturday.

captions: Dorrit ties a paper tag to every clock, and wants the laptop to print Edwina's.
Today she writes each one by hand, and on a busy day nobody can read them.
You build the tag's text from her slip, joining and cutting text, in four tasks.
Now the name, the width, the shelf code and the short item all print from the slip.
The paper slips are in the laptop now: tickets, bills and tags, all from your code.
